none: PAS NCL-E103D5: NCL-E103D5: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A military lead sealing dating to the Roman period. The sealing is circular in plan with a raised rectangular panel at its centre. This raised extension possesses a flat upper surface which is stamped with the legend 'LVI' in relief.
